# Security policy

Security fixes are provided through current GitHub releases. This is a
spare-time open-source project, so no response or resolution deadline is
guaranteed.

Potential security problems include unsafe command or path handling, unintended
file access, privilege-boundary mistakes, crashes caused by crafted launcher
data, or disclosure of private desktop information.

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/matteobonanomi/xfce4-meowmenu-plugin/security/advisories/new)
and include the affected version, environment, reproduction steps, impact, and
any proposed mitigation. Ordinary bugs belong in the public issue tracker.
